description: Saves a multiple-choice quiz whose questions are already written, by the user or by you, on Tjaz, and gives back a link to play it alone, in a 3D game or together on a big screen, and to share it. Use this when the user has the questions, e.g. pasted them, or asks you to write them. Tjaz checks the quiz against its terms before saving it

language.description: The language of the quiz: the language's code as Tjaz has it, ISO 639-1, e.g. da, en, ar, uk, and nb for Norwegian

players.description: Who will play the quiz. An age group: children (6–12), teens (13–17), adults (18–64), seniors (65+); or, for school, a level: grade0 is the first year of school at about 6 (kindergarten, Danish 0. klasse), grade1 to grade12 the school years after it (grade4 is US Grade 4, Danish 4. klasse, German 4. Klasse, UK Year 5; grade10–grade12 are the last three years of upper secondary school, e.g. Danish 1.g–3.g), then bachelor, master, phd, or nobel for experts. Leave it out when the user didn't say who will play: Tjaz then reads it from the description, as tjaz.com does

public.description: Whether the user wants it on tjaz.com/quizzes, where anyone can find it. A quiz from a chat is saved for those who get its link only; the user can show it on tjaz.com/quizzes from its Share dialog on tjaz.com

answers.description: Usually 4 short answers. Believable wrong answers. Vary the position of the right one

explanation.description: Optional: why the right answer is right, in 1–3 sentences, shown after the player answers

question.description: Short enough to read on a phone

right.description: The indexes in answers of the right answers, from 0: one, unless more than one answer is right on its own

title.description: A short title, at most 8 words

name: save_quiz

message.description: Why it was refused, or what to tell the user

bigScreen.description: Plays it together on a big screen, everyone playing along on their phone or laptop

edit.description: The editor, for the one who made it

play.description: The quiz's page, to play it and share it

qrCode.description: A QR code of the play link, as an SVG picture

team.description: Plays it on a big screen as one team against cute, silly monsters, everyone answering on their phone or laptop: the more answer right, the better the team defends, and each monster becomes its friend. Good for a class or a group of children

rating.description: The mean rating from 1 to 5, or null under 5 ratings

title: Save a quiz you wrote on Tjaz
